description: Comparison-grid meme pairing well-known tech-company logos with occult or Masonic symbols the image claims they resemble. Gmail is paired with a 'Masonic royal rich apron', Facebook with a 'Masonic Tubal Cain' emblem, the Apple App Store and Android product store with a Freemason square-and-compass emblem, Google Chrome with a 'divine king sign 666', Google Play with a 'Seal of Satan', and Google GPS with 'the Eye of Providence'. The pairings are the meme's claim of hidden symbolism, presented without evidence.
text: GMAIL. MASONIC ROYAL RICH APRON. FACEBOOK. MASONIC TUBAL CAIN. APPLE APP STORE. ANDROID PRODUCT STORE. FREEMASON. GOOGLE CHROME. DIVINE KING SIGN 666. GOOGLE PLAY. SEAL OF SATAN. GOOGLE GPS. THE EYE OF PROVIDENCE.
flags: Meme's claimed logo/occult-symbol correspondences are unverified assertions of hidden symbolism

description: Screenshot of the Reddit Premium promotional banner from Reddit's website. Left side shows the Reddit Snoo shield logo, the heading 'reddit premium', marketing text about an ad-free experience, and an orange 'GET REDDIT PREMIUM' button. Right side shows illustrated Snoo mascot characters around a heraldic crest with a banner reading 'MEMENTO HUMANI'; an Eye-of-Providence-style pyramid emblem is visible at the crest's upper corner.
text: reddit premium. Reddit Premium gives you an ad-free experience, special benefits, and directly supports Reddit. The more Reddit is user-supported, the freer we are to make Reddit the best it can be. GET REDDIT PREMIUM. MEMENTO HUMANI.

description: Press photograph (AP watermark) of then-U.S. Secretary of State Hillary Clinton, in a royal-blue jacket with head bowed and hands clasped, standing between two Gulf Arab officials in traditional white thobes, ghutra/keffiyeh headdresses and gold-trimmed bishts. The man at right is consistent with Saudi Foreign Minister Saud al-Faisal; the setting is consistent with a 2012 Gulf Cooperation Council forum in Saudi Arabia, though no caption confirms this.
flags: Man at right resembles Saud al-Faisal but is not confirmed by any visible caption; left official unidentified
Location and date inferred, not shown

description: Close-up photograph of Saudi billionaire Prince Alwaleed bin Talal wearing a red-and-white checkered ghutra with black agal and tinted glasses. Small, low-resolution image with no caption or text.

Press photograph (AFP/Getty Images watermark) of Prince Charles, wearing a grey pinstripe suit with a red remembrance poppy, speaking at a microphone inside an ornate wood-panelled lobby. Beside him stand Saudi Prince Alwaleed bin Talal in a dark suit and glasses and a woman in a cream outfit consistent with his then-wife Princess Ameerah al-Taweel, with security/staff at right. The setting is consistent with the ceremonial reopening of the Savoy Hotel in London (Alwaleed was its major investor), though no caption confirms this.
flags: Woman resembles Ameerah al-Taweel but not confirmed by visible caption
